items.teaser: A Russian strike damaged a residential building in central Odesa on 18 November, killing four and injuring nine. Medics are treating civilians at the scene.

items.title: Residential building damaged in Russian attack on central Odesa
items.teaser: A residential building in the city centre of Odesa was damaged in a Russian attack on the morning of November 18.

items.title: Strongest earthquake in years hits Romania, tremors felt in Ukraine
items.teaser: The earthquake had a magnitude of 5.7, according to Romania’s National Institute for Earth Physics.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1728: Ukraine drops road span of Kerch Bridge into sea
items.teaser: Ukraine needed little more than a day to bring down the Kerch Bridge that Russia spent years fortifying, using 11 types of missiles and drones.

items.title: The importance of work-life balance for mental health
items.teaser: Your job may be quietly shaping your sleep, your mood, and your joy more than you realize. Read on to spot the signs of imbalance and learn simple habits that bring your calm back.

items.title: Angriff aus Russland? Cyberattacke auf Eishockey-Weltverband
items.teaser: Mitten im Streit um Russlands Rückkehr wird der Eishockey-Weltverband IIHF gezielt gehackt. Auf seiner Website erscheint russische Propaganda. WM-Gastgeber Deutschland drängt nun auf Suspendierung der russischen Teams.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 165 Gefechte an der Front, die heftigsten Kämpfe dauern an sechs Abschnitten an
items.teaser: Am 17. November kam es zu 165 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front, die Mehrheit davon in Richtung Pokrowsk.

items.title: Russian forces strike market in Zlatopil, Kharkiv region, injuring 12 people, including child
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a market in the city of Zlatopil in the Kharkiv region, injuring 12 people, including an 11-year-old boy.

items.title: Russian forces attack industrial infrastructure in Zhytomyr region
items.teaser: Russian forces launched an overnight strike on industrial infrastructure in the Zhytomyr community.

items.teaser: Hours after Ukraine hit the Salavat refinery, Putin flew to China for talks with Xi and Trump, carrying a message that Russia’s economy keeps growing.

items.title: Putin says the economy is still growing. Ukrainian drones just set two more Russian refineries on fire—a day before his three-way meeting with Xi and Trump
items.teaser: Russian officials reached once more for falling drone debris to explain the fires, without naming the plants Ukraine has gone after again and again this year.

items.title: Ukraine: Kyiv targets Krasnodar refineries after felling Kerch bridge
items.teaser: Reports that two industrial facilities were targeted overnight in Krasnodar, after the Kerch bridge was put out of action by Ukrainian strikes.

items.title: Region Charkiw: Zwölf Verletzte bei Angriff auf Markt in Slatopil, darunter ein Kind
items.teaser: Russische Invasoren haben einen Markt in der Stadt Slatopil in der Region Charkiw angegriffen.

items.title: More than 80 settlements without electricity in Rivne region following Russian attack
items.teaser: More than 80 settlements in Ukraine’s Rivne region were left without electricity following a Russian attack on the morning of November 18.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 126 feindliche Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 126 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 17. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Drones attack Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries in Russia – media reports
items.teaser: On the night of Wednesday, November 18, drones attacked Russia’s Krasnodar region, targeting the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries.

items.title: Russen beschießen acht Ortschaften und töten vier Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 17. November töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk vier Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Russia drops 40 aerial bombs in 10 days: families with children to be evacuated from Balabyne in Zaporizhzhia Oblast
items.teaser: The authorities plan to evacuate 184 residents, including 85 children, from Balabyne following intensified Russian airstrikes. Officials aim to complete the main evacuation measures within a week.

items.title: $1.6 bln at stake: Finance Ministry reports significant progress in talks with IMF mission
items.teaser: The in-person stage of the International Monetary Fund's mission on the second and third reviews of Ukraine's Extended Fund Facility (EFF) program has concluded in Warsaw.

items.title: Russian attacks kill one, injures eight in Kharkiv region
items.teaser: Over the past 24 hours, 16 settlements in the Kharkiv region came under Russian attack. One person was killed and eight others were injured.

items.title: Has Ukraine disrupted operations at Russia's airports?
In Region Cherson 35 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 35 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurden Zivilisten weder getötet noch verletzt.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,629,010 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,970 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Air defence neutralises 126 Russian drones used to attack Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's Air Defence Forces neutralised 126 drones that Russia used to attack Ukraine starting on the evening of November 17.

items.title: Drohnenangriff auf russische Ölraffinerien Afipski und Ilskij
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum Mittwoch, dem 18. November, griffen Drohnen die Region Krasnodar der Russischen Föderation an.

items.title: Twelve injured, including child, in Russian strike on market in Kharkiv Oblast
items.teaser: A Russian strike on a market in Zlatopil, Kharkiv Oblast, on 18 November injured 12 civilians, including an 11-year-old boy, and caused a major fire. Emergency services have arrived at the scene.

items.title: Drones in flight, flights on hold: has Ukraine disrupted operations at Russia's airports?
items.teaser: On 1 September 2026, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that "Russian airspace is becoming completely unsafe".

items.title: Ten F-16s and two Mirage jets by year-end: Ukraine's partners announce military aid plans
items.teaser: At the 37th Ramstein meeting in Brussels, Ukraine's partners outlined new air defence funding, drone procurement and ammunition deliveries, with Belgium pledging 10 F-16s and France two Mirage fighters by the end of 2026.

items.title: Russische Armee verliert 1.970 weitere Soldaten und sechs Artilleriesysteme an einem Tag
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine belaufen sich vom 24. Februar 2022 bis zum 18. November 2026 auf rund 1.629.010 Soldaten, darunter 1.970 weitere Verluste allein im Laufe des letzten Tages.

items.title: Ukraine's public sector deficit may rise to 17% of GDP in 2027 – European Commission
items.teaser: Ukraine's public sector deficit is expected to remain elevated amid substantial war-related spending needs.

items.title: Close-up footage of Crimean Bridge from occupied Crimea shows road section destroyed but railway operational – photos, video
items.teaser: Close-up images posted by Ukrainian OSINT community Exilenova+ show the missing arch and road span of the Crimean Bridge, with the footage taken from a train crossing its railway section after the attack.

items.title: Four people killed in Russian attacks on Donetsk Oblast, including married couple
items.teaser: Two people were killed in Sloviansk, with one death recorded in each of Shabelkivka and Yasnohirka. Donetsk Oblast authorities say their casualty figures exclude Mariupol and Volnovakha.

items.title: Russian army attacks Dnipro, Dnipro region, injuring six people
items.teaser: Russian forces have been attacking the city of Dnipro and the Nikopol district of Dnipropetrovsk region with drones since the evening of November 17. Six people, including a child, were injured.

items.title: Russia loses 1,970 troops over past day in war against Ukraine
items.teaser: The total estimated combat losses of Russian forces since the beginning of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, through November 18, 2026, amount to approximately 1,629,010 personnel, including 1,970 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 55 Ortschaften beschossen, zwei Zivilisten getötet, 49 verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 55 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 864 Mal.

items.title: Ukrainian air defence downs 126 Russian drones, strikes recorded at seven locations
items.teaser: Russia launched 141 drones overnight. Ukrainian forces destroyed or jammed 126 drones, while strikes were recorded at seven locations.

items.title: Six injured in Russian attack on Dnipro, including teenager
items.teaser: Six people were injured in Russian drone attacks on two districts of Dnipro, with a 37-year-old woman in a serious condition. Residential buildings, student accommodation, a park and infrastructure facilities were damaged.

items.title: Kalibr missile strike on Kyiv apartment building: Ukraine issues in-absentia notice of suspicion to Russian vice admiral
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) and the Prosecutor's Office have issued an in-absentia notice of suspicion to Russian Black Sea Fleet Vice Admiral Arkady Romanov for his alleged involvement in directing Kalibr cruise missiles at a residential apartment building in Kyiv in July 2024.

items.title: Stefanchuk, Costa discuss prospects for opening final two EU negotiating clusters by end of year
items.teaser: Chairman of the Verkhovna Rada Ruslan Stefanchuk and European Council President António Costa discussed in Brussels the possibility of opening the final two EU accession negotiating clusters for Ukraine by the end of this year.

items.title: Drones attack Russia's Krasnodar Krai, fire breaks out at oil refinery – videos
items.teaser: Explosions and air defence response were reported near the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries overnight. Local residents also reported a strike and casualties in the settlement of Afipsky.

items.title: UN Security Council to hold high-level meeting on Ukraine
items.teaser: The United Nations Security Council will convene a high-level meeting on Monday, November 23, to discuss Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: Red carpet and marching troops: Putin arrives in China for meeting with Trump and Xi
items.teaser: Vladimir Putin has landed in Shenzhen for a meeting with the US and Chinese leaders on 19 November. Chinese officials welcomed him with a red carpet, marching troops and dancers ahead of the APEC summit.

items.title: Lubinets: More than 24,700 children remain in residential institutions in Ukraine, thousands more in temporarily occupied territories
items.teaser: A total of 24,754 children remain in residential care institutions across Ukraine, while thousands more are in temporarily occupied territories.

items.title: 2 Russian oil refineries reportedly targeted in overnight drone attack on Krasnodar Krai
items.teaser: The Ilsky and Afipsky refineries are both located in Krasnodar Krai's Seversky district and have been repeatedly targeted in Ukrainian drone attacks.

items.title: Russia loses 1,970 soldiers. 34 artillery systems and one bridge over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,970 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Canada announces new military aid package for Ukraine
items.teaser: Canada's latest assistance package includes additional funding for the Czech ammunition initiative, specialised air defence sensors, winter military equipment, 1.6 million rounds of ammunition and 250,000 field rations

items.title: Canada to allocate $120M in military aid to Ukraine
items.teaser: The Canadian government has announced a new military assistance package for Ukraine, which will include ammunition, specialised sensors for air defence systems, military equipment and individual combat rations.

items.title: RMAs must ensure support and integration for evacuated residents of Oleshky community – Lubinets
items.teaser: Regional military administrations must ensure proper support and integration into local communities for residents evacuated from Oleshky, in the Kherson region.

items.title: Germany, UK push back after US criticizes Ukraine's deep strikes into Russia
items.teaser: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius strongly rejected Colby's assessment, calling criticism of Ukrainian strikes against strategic military targets inside Russia "quite a stupid thing."

items.title: Cashless card transactions continue to grow in 2026 – NBU
items.teaser: The number of cashless transactions made with payment cards in Ukraine rose 7.5% year-on-year in January-September 2026, while their total value increased 16.6%.

items.title: International hockey federation hit by cyberattack after Russia barred from World Juniors
items.teaser: The perpetrators have not been identified. Before the website went offline, an image of Russian hockey players appeared alongside a message reading, “SCARED TO FACE RUSSIA? You banned the only team you can't beat.”

items.title: Prince Harry presented with book 'Unbreakable Kherson' during visit to Ukraine
items.teaser: During his visit to Ukraine, Britain's Prince Harry was presented with a copy of the book “Unbreakable Kherson,” as well as drawings by a nine-year-old girl from Kherson that she made in a shelter.

items.title: Ukraine, Germany to launch joint production of unmanned ground systems – Pistorius
items.teaser: Germany and Ukraine are setting up another joint venture to manufacture unmanned ground vehicles in Germany for subsequent delivery to the Ukrainian military.

items.title: Neue Quartalszahlen: Nvidia verdoppelt Umsatz und Gewinn
items.teaser: Wenige Tage nach der Spionageaffäre rund um den bisherigen Konzernchef Huang hat Nvidia überraschend starke Quartalsergebnisse vorgelegt. Die Zahlen des US-Chipkonzerns lagen deutlich über den Erwartungen von Analysten.

items.title: Umfrage der EU-Kommission zu den Exportkontrollpraktiken bei immateriellen Transfers von Gütern mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck (ITT)
items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.
